$comment: Corpus manifest — the sibling repos etymd validates against (the dogfood harness). Entries are named by SHAPE, not by directory: the local directory for each comes from an untracked sources.local.json (see README). Corpus tests skip cleanly wherever a repo is absent, so a fresh clone runs them as no-ops.
